title: Scalar Gaussian NVFP4 Quantized Training
intuition: Extreme 4-bit quantization stress test training N(2, 0.5^2) through software-reference NVFP4 (E2M1 with micro-block scaling) across FPROP, DGRAD, and WGRAD without losing distribution accuracy (KS <= 0.05).
failure_mode: Severe 4-bit quantization noise destroys fine gradient signals, breaks finite-difference critic penalties via ULP rounding, or stalls convergence on small step updates.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 stretch benchmark using emulated NVFP4 Linear layers; native kernel parity remains unverified.
